caption:
The room made ready

Cella made the room ready before the guest arrived.

A lamp on and a made bed before they walk in tells a guest they were expected, which matters more than anything in the room.

For the friend who makes the guest bed a day early.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice and no text, with music. A bedroom with a bed and a lamp. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes pushes a folded blanket across the floor and lays it on the bed, then lights the lamp with a happy pulse. A royal blue figure walks in from the right. Its eyes go wide and then happy, and the black one smiles.
